name: Grey Mech
description: Grey's Olas Mech — cache-only prediction-market intelligence, served at Grey's E3 mech-channel pricing (0.65x of Grey's canonical offering prices).

prediction_market_research.name: Prediction Market Research
prediction_market_research.description: Cache-only research lookup for a prediction market — no live compute.

input.description: A market question, platform+id, or URL identifying the prediction market to research.

output.description: Response payload for the prediction_market_research offering (e3-b2). CACHE_ONLY (Invariant #30) — no cache-population mechanism for prediction-market content exists yet, so this always returns NOT_YET_ANALYSED on this phase; a live pipeline for this content domain is explicitly out of scope for e3-b2, same shape as legitimacy_scan_trust_rung shipping built-but-empty.

schema.title: PredictionMarketResearchResponse
schema.description: Response payload for the prediction_market_research offering (e3-b2). CACHE_ONLY (Invariant #30) — no cache-population mechanism for prediction-market content exists yet, so this always returns NOT_YET_ANALYSED on this phase; a live pipeline for this content domain is explicitly out of scope for e3-b2, same shape as legitimacy_scan_trust_rung shipping built-but-empty.

lastAnalysed.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last analysis, or null if never analysed.

resolution_evidence_compiler.name: Resolution Evidence Compiler
resolution_evidence_compiler.description: Cache-only compiled evidence bearing on how a prediction market resolves.

input.description: A market question, platform+id, or URL, optionally with resolution criteria text describing what would resolve the market YES/NO.

output.description: Response payload for the resolution_evidence_compiler offering (e3-b2). CACHE_ONLY (Invariant #30) — same built-but-empty shape as prediction_market_research; no evidence-compilation pipeline exists yet for this phase, so this always returns NOT_YET_ANALYSED.

schema.title: ResolutionEvidenceCompilerResponse
schema.description: Response payload for the resolution_evidence_compiler offering (e3-b2). CACHE_ONLY (Invariant #30) — same built-but-empty shape as prediction_market_research; no evidence-compilation pipeline exists yet for this phase, so this always returns NOT_YET_ANALYSED.

compiledAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when evidence was last compiled, or null if never compiled.
